title: E1 SWA window sweep (64/256/1024), 20M tokens, 4 seeds, one RTX 5090
status: exploratory (notes/statistics-policy.md section 4): never changes a claim status
registered: experiments/checks/PREDICTIONS.md, section 'Registered SQ214 window-sweep...' (v0.4.71) + pre-run amendment (v0.4.72)

verdicts.W1: FAIL: |w1024 - w256| = +1.30% (predicted <= 1.0%), and in the opposite direction (full attention is worse)
verdicts.W2: PASS: w64 is +0.76% worse than w256 (predicted +0.3..+2.0%); paired t 2.91 < 3.18, so not significant at 95% on its own
verdicts.W3: FAIL: order is w256 < w64 < w1024 (predicted w1024 <= w256 <= w64)
verdicts.decision_rule: no confirmatory 200M run: w1024 does not beat w256 (it loses by 0.0058 bpc, > 2x seed sd 0.0035). C193's window explanation loses support; SQ219/SQ226 are next

caveats: 20M tokens only: full attention may need more data than SWA to pay off
docs > 1,024 tokens are scored in chunks (SQ226 confound)
in-training val_loss is on the contaminated val; only clean80 is used here
